description:
**Job Details:**

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Senior Azure DevOps Engineer - Full-Stack and Hybrid Cloud Systems
  
Bangalore, India ' Full-Time
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an experienced, versatile Azure DevOps Engineer to join our team and become a genuine part of what we are building.
  
This is not a straightforward DevOps role. Our system spans a full-stack web application, a rich and deliberately complex Azure cloud environment, and on-premises Linux lab infrastructure that talks directly to FPGA hardware. The person who thrives here will be someone who gets energized by that kind of variety, not overwhelmed by it.
  
Just as importantly, we are looking for someone who communicates well, enjoys working closely with developers and customers, and takes real pride in the quality and reliability of what they build and maintain. Technical depth matters, but so does being someone the team genuinely enjoys working with.
  
The Environment You Will Be Working In
  
The Application
  
We build and operate a full-stack web application with a Node.js server, TypeScript services, and a React.js client. The application connects to on-premises Linux lab environments where a Python-based layer orchestrates and controls FPGA hardware. The cloud and the physical lab need to talk to each other reliably, securely, and continuously.
  
The Internal Azure Subscription
  
This environment is mature, fully operational, and genuinely complex. Containerized workloads run on Kubernetes. We use the right database for the right job: relational databases for structured data, a document store for flexibility, in-memory caching for performance, distributed file storage for shared access, and large-scale telemetry and analytics through Azure Data Explorer. Identity and access management spans SSO, Active Directory, Kerberos, and Microsoft Entra ID, because our permission model is real-world complex, not textbook simple. We also run an internal HPC-grade job scheduling system that manages compute resource allocation and permissions across lab infrastructure.
  
The External Azure Subscription
  
This subscription is starting now and will serve customers outside our organization. Security, network architecture, compliance, and performance are the foundation here, not afterthoughts. You will be building this alongside our network and cybersecurity teams with genuine ownership of getting it right.
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
CI/CD and Developer Support
  
Design, maintain, and continuously improve pipelines covering the full delivery lifecycle for our Node.js, TypeScript, and React codebase. When something breaks in a pipeline or a release goes sideways, the development team will come to you, and you will be the person who unblocks them calmly and effectively. Beyond day-to-day support, you will raise the quality bar by embedding good practices into the workflow: automated testing, regression coverage, reproducible builds, and documentation that people actually use.
  
Automation and AI-Driven Operations
  
We want a platform that monitors itself, detects problems, and recovers on its own wherever possible. When it cannot, it should tell us clearly and give us what we need to act fast. We want you to use AI tools actively and creatively to get there, whether that means intelligent alerting, automated remediation, generated runbooks, or things we have not thought of yet. Every repeated manual task is a candidate for automation.
  
Platform and Infrastructure Engineering
  
Own the day-to-day health and long-term evolution of our internal Azure environment: Kubernetes workloads, data services, storage, networking, and identity systems. Maintain the bridge between cloud and lab, keeping our Linux hosts and hardware systems connected and operational as the platform grows.
  
Security and the External-Facing Cloud
  
Work closely with our network and cybersecurity teams to design and harden the external subscription before customers ever touch it. Zero-trust access, network segmentation, secrets management, private endpoints, and audit logging need to be built in from the start. We need someone who thinks about security architecturally, not just operationally.
  
Required Qualifications

The work is technically rich and varied in a way that is hard to find. You will not be executing tickets. You will be shaping how the platform evolves, with real ownership and real impact on both the team that builds the product and the customers who use it. Then you'll build those systems and make sure they keep working after you move on to the next problem.

You'll work across CloudOps, every product engineering team, Security, and Engineering leadership. Your influence will reach well beyond the code you write yourself.

  

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Architecture:** Set the long-term direction for LeadSquared's cloud infrastructure across all products and environments through design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Lead migrations from today's estate to a standardised platform without customer impact.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Bring all infrastructure under reviewed code with safe change practices, including PR-driven plan and apply, policy as code, drift detection, and production guardrails.

* **Reliability:** Define SLOs, own observability, lead major incidents and postmortems, and regularly test disaster recovery.
* **Security and Compliance:** Enforce least-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption by default. Support audits through automated evidence collection.
* **Cost Optimisation:** Treat cloud spend as an engineering metric, with visibility into costs per product, tenant, and service.
* **Leadership:** Mentor engineers, represent CloudOps to product teams, and eliminate operational toil through automation.

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with clear ownership of production systems at meaningful scale.
* Deep, hands-on **AWS** expertise, including multi-account organisations, networking, IAM, compute, containers, managed data services, and edge delivery.

* Expert-level **Kubernetes** experience in production, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, RBAC, and debugging under pressure.
* Production experience with **CI/CD and GitOps** practices.
* Experience running and migrating a large, existing production estate, not just building greenfield environments.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language, with the ability to build production-grade tooling.
* A track record of leading incidents, writing postmortems, and delivering the reliability improvements that follow.
* Proven ability to write clear technical documents and influence decisions across teams without formal authority.

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing or operating highly available, active-active, or disaster recovery (DR) architectures in the cloud.
* Experience leading large-scale migrations, such as moving from virtual machines to containers, with zero or near-zero customer impact.
* Experience building an observability practice with SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience with policy as code and software supply chain security.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms, including tenant isolation models, per-tenant routing, and capacity management.
* FinOps experience with demonstrable cloud cost reductions.
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling or public speaking and writing on platform engineering.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

  

### **First 90 Days**

* Understand LeadSquared's infrastructure end to end across products, accounts, and environments, and join the on-call and incident commander rotation.
* Deliver at least one meaningful improvement to change safety or developer experience across teams.
* Produce a written assessment of the platform's top reliability, security, and cost risks, along with a proposed roadmap.

* New environments can be provisioned from code in days, not weeks.
* Most production infrastructure is managed as code and changed only through reviewed pull requests.
* SLOs are defined for critical customer journeys, alerting is driven by them, and error budgets inform release decisions.
* Disaster recovery has been tested end to end, with documented results.
* Cloud spend per unit of load is measurably lower.
* At least two engineers on the team are operating at the next level as a result of your mentorship.

* **Standards over snowflakes:** One consistent way to build an environment, deploy a service, and manage observability.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You have spent years keeping large\-scale compute environments running, not just available but actually performant, under the kind of load that makes most infrastructure buckle. You understand that when an engineer's simulation job sits in queue for six hours instead of six minutes, that is not a scheduler problem, it is a planning problem, a tuning problem, or a resource allocation problem, and you are the person who figures out which one and fixes it before it becomes a pattern.


You think in systems, not tickets. When LSF or Slurm throws an error, you do not just restart the service, you trace it back to the workload spike, the misconfigured policy, or the storage bottleneck that triggered it. You have built enough automation to know that the script is the easy part, the hard part is designing it so it does not create three new problems when the environment shifts next quarter.


You are comfortable in a room with R\&D engineers who need 10,000 cores by Tuesday and cloud architects who want to move half the farm to Azure, and you can translate between those conversations without losing the thread of what actually has to work. At Synopsys, you will work on HPC infrastructure that powers the chip design tools the world depends on, and the decisions you make will directly affect how fast our engineers can build the next generation of silicon.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and optimize large\-scale HPC compute farm platforms that support thousands of engineering workloads across global sites
* Administer and tune IBM Spectrum LSF, Slurm, or equivalent workload schedulers to maximize resource utilization and minimize job queue times
* Lead capacity planning and workload optimization efforts, translating engineering demand into infrastructure requirements and deployment timelines
* Drive automation using Python and Shell scripting to eliminate manual toil, improve reliability, and accelerate incident response
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis for platform issues, working across storage, networking, LDAP, NFS, and scheduler layers
* Collaborate with R\&D, Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security teams on strategic initiatives including cloud\-integrated HPC and AI/ML workload enablement
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across global teams, setting standards for operational excellence and engineering rigor
* Participate in 24x5 support operations and lead major infrastructure projects from design through deployment

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable faster product development cycles by ensuring high availability and performance of the compute infrastructure that powers Synopsys EDA tools
* Maximize infrastructure utilization and license efficiency, directly reducing costs and improving engineering productivity across the company
* Reduce incident response time and platform downtime through automation, monitoring, and proactive capacity management
* Accelerate cloud adoption and modernization efforts, helping Synopsys scale compute resources dynamically to meet global engineering demand
* Improve workload throughput and job completion times, giving engineers more iterations per day and faster feedback loops
* Build operational resilience into the platform, ensuring that infrastructure scales reliably as the business grows
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the global infrastructure engineering team, raising the bar for how we operate and support critical systems

### **What You'll Need**

* 8\+ years of Linux/UNIX systems administration experience with deep expertise in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and large\-scale operations
* 5\+ years of hands\-on HPC or compute farm administration, including workload scheduling, resource management, and capacity planning
* Strong expertise in IBM Spectrum LSF, Slurm, or equivalent schedulers, including policy configuration, job prioritization, and performance optimization
* Advanced knowledge of LDAP, NFS, DNS, enterprise storage systems, and networking in the context of distributed compute environments

* Solid understanding of monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic, or Splunk for proactive incident detection and analysis
* Experience with EDA environments is a strong plus, as is familiarity with cloud\-integrated HPC platforms on Azure or AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, or Terraform
